notes.title: Inventory Update
notes.notes:
Thanks for playing and for leaving valuable feedback!
A new trailer is also out, you can check it out on the store page!

Demo version 1.1 changelog:
[list]
[*]Added an inventory system, it can be toggled using the Tab key or Y on a controller
[*]Every item you pick up is added to your inventory where you can learn more about it
[*]Added UI sounds for all menus
[*]Added a volume slider for UI sounds in the settings
[*]Fixed audio settings not being loaded when opening the game sometimes
[*]Fixed UI for 4:3 resolutions
[*]Color coded certain keys and doors to make them more distinct
[*]Made some more various small visual changes to the level
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3346770/Split_Apart_Demo/

notes.title: Another Demo Update
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing and for all the valuable feedback during Steam Next Fest!

Demo version 1.07 changelog:
[list]
[*] Added a Settings menu for adjusting volume, changing resolution, and toggling fullscreen
[*] Added more textures and sounds
[*] Added D-pad support
[*] Fixed clipping issues and going out of bounds from the bathrooms
[*] Fixed item messages disappearing too soon
[*] Made adjustments to camera angles and camera triggers in certain areas
[*] Made various small visual changes to the level
[*] Ported the game from Unity 2021 to Unity 6
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3346770/Split_Apart_Demo/

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
First I'd like to thank everyone who gave the demo a spin and left some feedback on how it can be improved.

Demo version 1.06 changelog:
[list]
[*] Fixed clipping on a couch that allowed the player to go out of bounds
[*] Fixed pause menu controls screen bug
[*] Fixed environment descriptions getting in the way of item pickup messages in some spots
[*] Fixed certain camera triggers
[*] Fixed minor grammar mistake
[*] Tweaked the player's animation speeds slightly
[*] Tweaked the time requirements for ranks you get on the end screen
[*] Slightly increased enemy hitbox
[*] Added bullet impact sounds for enemies
[*] Added death sounds for enemies
[*] Added fire alarms in hallway
[*] Unified the key and gun pickup in the red room
[*] Interacting with the coin box now tells you how many coins you have collected
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3346770/Split_Apart_Demo/
